goal: Prove read-first whether the Configuration Packages page can expose a package card/table surface for Foundation setup mapping without creating, changing, importing, validating, applying or deleting package data.
whyNow: The local write-gate decision found that Configuration Packages are source-backed and visible, but package-card, table-line and field-selection evidence is missing. A write gate would be premature until the card/table surface is visually proven.
expectedOutput: Read-first Result JSON with screenshot QA and visual-state classification for Configuration Packages and any existing package-card/table surface.
Before/after screenshots for each relevant navigation step.
Clear verdict whether package-card/table-surface evidence is enough for a later narrow write gate or whether the package route stays parked.
stopConditions: Stop if the page is not playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Stop if Business Central asks to create, edit, import, export, validate, apply or delete anything.
Stop if U-VAT325-DISC is not clearly visible or cannot be opened without edit/write semantics.
Stop if only Search/Tell-Me, Role Center background or an ambiguous side pane is visible and Screenshot QA cannot classify the foreground.
Stop if a route would repeat Escape-after-Tell-Me or old grid/list-edit retries without a materially new visual-state hypothesis.
Stop before any package metadata or setup write.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the package card/table surface is visually proven and one narrow keep-worthy or reversible metadata action can be named.
Use if the package card/table surface remains ambiguous or unsafe.
Use after the package route is either proven enough for a later gate or parked with a clear blocker.
